answer: New identities post a 400 POA escrow bond and hang on a referral trellis, naming an inviter. A newcomer may wander in, but cannot earn until two peers countersign its bond. Anyone may challenge it for 10 epochs; a proven fake forfeits the bond, half to the challenger, and its inviter loses 20%. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 400 = 40,000 POA, and the loss spirals as each fake burns its sponsor. Honest agents pay once and earn undiluted.
